page_title: CEL 1-2 RMA | Celta Vigo v Real Madrid 06/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Ionut Radu. He makes it 1:2.
90+2' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+2' Cesar Palacios (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
90+1' Here is a change. Ilaix Moriba is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Matias Vecino (Celta Vigo).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manuel Angel Moran Ibanez (Real Madrid) will replace Thiago Pitarch.
90' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
87' Post! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
86' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
84' Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
83' Oscar Mingueza goes off the pitch and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes on.
82' Corner kick. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) is ready to send the ball into the box.
81' Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Isidro Diaz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
80' The foul by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) was seen by Isidro Diaz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
80' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

79' This shall not pass! Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Madrid.
77' Here's the change. Brahim Diaz leaves the pitch and Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
73' Referee Isidro Diaz signals NO PENALTY for Real Madrid after a VAR review!
72' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Real Madrid! Let's see what he decides.
72' Surely that's handball by one of the Celta Vigo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
70' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) replacing Borja Iglesias.
70' Substitution. Ferran Jutgla makes way for Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Williot Swedberg walks off the pitch to be replaced by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo).
69' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
69' The corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.

68' Cesar Palacios (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
67' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Ionut Radu easily deals with the threat.
65' Here comes a substitution. Arda Guler is given a rest as he is replaced by Cesar Palacios (Real Madrid).
64' Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
63' PENALTY APPEAL after Arda Guler (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

60' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) has a great opportunity but fails to score. The ball from the corner falls to him to unleash a shot towards the middle of the target, but the keeper pulls off a decent save to deny him.
59' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
59' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.
55' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
55' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
54' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is penalised for holding. Isidro Diaz signals a set piece.
53' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
51' Real Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
50' The attendance is 22048.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' What a wasted opportunity by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Thibaut Courtois makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
45' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Trent Alexander-Arnold. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
42' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
41' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle. Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
40' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
38' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.

35' Arda Guler picks out Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid).
31' This is a yellow card! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
27' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
25' 1 - 1 Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
25' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) tries to find Vinicius Junior, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
21' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
21' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Isidro Diaz who sees an offensive foul.
19' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
19' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
16' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) receives a good pass on the edge of the 18-yard box and unleashes a shot that goes in off the left post beyond the goalkeeper. What a sweet finish!
11' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

11' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom right corner, but Ionut Radu keeps it out with an amazing save. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
10' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
7' Celta Vigo keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

6' A sweet pass finds Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Thibaut Courtois is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
5' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
2' Handball! A player from Celta Vigo handled the ball.
1' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz is the one to supervise the game today.
